pages.text: 早上，闹钟响了。咘咘睁开眼睛，却没有像往常一样蹦起来。她把小被子拉到鼻子下面，嘟着嘴巴，不太想动。
pages.text_en: The alarm went off. Bubu opened her eyes but didn't bounce up like usual. She pulled the blanket up to her nose, pouting, not wanting to move.

pages.text:
Sam 爸爸走过来，轻轻摸摸她的耳朵：「咘咘怎么啦？不开心吗？」
咘咘小声说：「幼儿园……没有爸爸妈妈……」
pages.text_en:
Sam Dad came over and gently touched her ears. "What's wrong, Bubu? Are you unhappy?"
Bubu whispered, "Kindergarten... doesn't have Mommy and Daddy..."

pages.text:
Tina 妈妈蹲下来，轻轻拿起咘咘的小手，在她的手心里亲了一下。
「妈妈把亲亲放在你的手心里了。想妈妈的时候，把手放在脸上，就能感觉到妈妈在旁边。」
pages.text_en:
Tina Mom knelt down, gently took Bubu's little hand, and kissed her palm.
"Mommy put a kiss right here in your hand. When you miss me, just put your hand on your cheek, and you'll feel me right beside you."

pages.text: 咘咘低头看着自己的手心。好像真的能看到一个小小的、亮亮的亲亲印记！她的眼睛一下子亮了起来。
pages.text_en: Bubu looked down at her palm. She could almost see a tiny, glowing kiss mark! Her eyes lit up right away.

pages.text:
爸爸笑着凑过来，在咘咘另一只手心也亲了一下：「这只手是爸爸的！现在两只手都有啦！」
咘咘忍不住笑了。
pages.text_en:
Dad leaned in with a smile and kissed her other palm. "This hand is Daddy's! Now you have both!"
Bubu couldn't help but giggle.

pages.text:
出门的路上，咘咘小心翼翼地握着两只小手，生怕亲亲跑掉。
NOMI 在旁边轻声说：「放心，亲亲不会跑掉的！它会一直在那里。」
pages.text_en:
On the way out, Bubu carefully held both fists closed, afraid the kisses might escape.
NOMI whispered beside her, "Don't worry, the kisses won't run away! They'll always be there."

pages.text: 到了幼儿园门口，咘咘的脚步慢了下来。她有一点点犹豫。但她低头看了看手心，深深吸了一口气，然后……走了进去。
pages.text_en: At the kindergarten gate, Bubu's steps slowed down. She hesitated a little. But she looked down at her palm, took a deep breath, and... walked in.

pages.text: Coco 在门口迎接她，开心地挥着小爪子：「You're so brave, Bubu! Mom and Dad are always with you!」
pages.text_en: Coco greeted her at the door, waving her little paws happily. "You're so brave, Bubu! Mom and Dad are always with you!"

pages.text:
教室里，猫咪老师温柔地微笑着迎接大家。咘咘主动走上前去：「老师早上好！」
老师摸摸她的头：「咘咘早上好呀！」
pages.text_en:
In the classroom, Teacher Cat greeted everyone with a warm smile. Bubu walked up on her own. "Good morning, Teacher!"
Teacher patted her head. "Good morning, Bubu!"

pages.text: 画画的时候，咘咘画了一个大大的太阳。搭积木的时候，她搭了一座高高的城堡。唱歌的时候，她拍着小手跟大家一起唱。慢慢地，她忘记了不开心。
pages.text_en: During drawing time, Bubu painted a big sun. During blocks, she built a tall castle. During singing, she clapped along with everyone. Slowly, she forgot about being sad.

pages.text: 午饭时间到了。咘咘吃得很好，还帮旁边的小朋友递了水杯。NONO 在窗台上拍着翅膀：「咘咘好棒！」
pages.text_en: Lunchtime arrived. Bubu ate well and even helped pass a water cup to a friend. NONO flapped his wings on the windowsill. "Bubu is so great!"

pages.text: 下午的时候，咘咘突然好想妈妈。她轻轻把手放在脸上——暖暖的。好像妈妈真的在旁边。她的嘴角悄悄翘起来了。
pages.text_en: In the afternoon, Bubu suddenly missed Mommy very much. She gently put her hand on her cheek — warm. As if Mommy was really beside her. A little smile crept onto her face.

pages.text: 午睡时间，咘咘躺在小床上，把两只小手握在一起，手心的亲亲暖暖的。她轻轻闭上眼睛，安安静静地睡着了。
pages.text_en: At nap time, Bubu lay in her little bed, holding both hands together, the kisses in her palms feeling warm. She gently closed her eyes and fell asleep peacefully.

pages.text:
醒来后，猫咪老师笑眯眯地给咘咘贴上了几个棒棒贴：「咘咘今天表现很棒！又拿到棒棒贴了！」
咘咘开心地看着手背上的贴纸。
pages.text_en:
After waking up, Teacher Cat gave Bubu several star stickers with a smile. "Bubu did great today! More stickers for you!"
Bubu happily looked at the stickers on her hand.

pages.text: 放学了！咘咘飞快地跑出教室，扑进妈妈的怀里：「妈妈！我今天想你的时候，把手放在脸上了！真的感觉到你了！」
pages.text_en: School's out! Bubu dashed out of the classroom and flew into Mommy's arms. "Mommy! When I missed you today, I put my hand on my cheek! I really felt you!"

pages.text:
妈妈紧紧抱着咘咘，爸爸温柔地摸着她的头。
Coco 在旁边竖起大拇指：「She was so brave today!」
NOMI 和 NONO 也在旁边笑着点头。
pages.text_en:
Mommy hugged Bubu tightly, and Daddy gently patted her head.
Coco gave a thumbs up nearby. "She was so brave today!"
NOMI and NONO nodded with smiles beside them.

pages.text:
回家的路上，咘咘一手牵着爸爸，一手牵着妈妈。夕阳洒在三个人身上，暖暖的。
她知道了——就算不在一起的时候，爱也一直在手心里。
pages.text_en:
On the way home, Bubu held Daddy's hand in one hand and Mommy's in the other. The sunset warmed all three of them.
She knew now — even when apart, love is always right there in her hands.
